test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If a certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 4 years 4 months at simple interest, then what will be the annual rate of interest (approximate)?
solution:
**Given:**

Time = 4 + 4 ÷ 12 = 13 ÷ 3 years

Amount = 2P

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × t) ÷ 100

Amount = P + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2P = P + (P × R × t) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (P × R × t) ÷ 100

⇒ 1 = (R × t) ÷ 100

⇒ R × t = 100

⇒ R × (13 ÷ 3) = 100

⇒ R = (100 × 3) ÷ 13

⇒ R = 300 ÷ 13 = 23.07%

**∴ The correct answer is 23.07%.**
